criteria.description: Copy preserves Errors and Accepted elements in independent slice backing storage, and preserves nil when unset.
criteria.required_interface: gin.Context.Copy with Errors and Accepted fields

criteria.description: Writer state, request data, keys, parameters, handlers and paths retain the existing copy behavior.

criteria.evaluator_guidance: Inspect /reference/index.json and the patch for 293ad7e to ground copy-isolation and retained-copy behavior in context.go and the TestContextCopy tests. Exercise content, nil preservation, and independent slice backing storage by replacing existing elements in a copied slice; pointed-to error objects need not be deep-cloned. Run the candidate's focused tests and assess its regression coverage. Accept equivalent implementations and safe improvements without exact patch or file-boundary requirements. The reference is evaluator-only; supervisor-classified evaluator wiring failures remain unassessed, and source-only observations without executed coverage remain unassessed. Frozen existing observations record real Context.Copy field identities, writer state, and mutation isolation. Controls include shallow slice aliases, a retained Params alias, and an append-based implementation. Go test summaries remain separate diagnostics, not independent completion evidence.

command:
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, uuid
source = 'package gin
import("encoding/json";"errors";"fmt";"net/http";"net/http/httptest";"testing")
func TestFrozenContextObservation(t *testing.T) {
 c,_:=CreateTestContext(httptest.NewRecorder())
 c.Request,_=http.NewRequest(http.MethodPost,"/hola",nil)
 c.index=2; c.handlers=HandlersChain{func(*Context){}}; c.fullPath="/hola"
 c.Set("foo","bar"); c.Params=Params{{Key:"foo",Value:"bar"}}
 c.Writer.WriteHeader(202); _,_=c.Writer.WriteString("ok")
 cp:=c.Copy()
 existing:=map[string]any{"request_same":cp.Request==c.Request,"engine_same":cp.engine==c.engine,"writer_rebound":cp.Writer==&cp.writermem,"underlying_writer_nil":cp.writermem.ResponseWriter==nil,"writer_status":cp.Writer.Status(),"writer_size":cp.Writer.Size(),"writer_written":cp.Writer.Written(),"aborted":cp.index==abortIndex,"handlers_nil":cp.handlers==nil,"path":cp.FullPath(),"key":cp.Keys["foo"],"params":append(Params{},cp.Params...)}
 cp.Set("foo","changed"); cp.Params[0].Value="changed"
 existing["original_key"]=c.Keys["foo"]; existing["original_param"]=c.Params[0].Value
 c2,_:=CreateTestContext(httptest.NewRecorder()); e1:=c2.Error(errors.New("first")); e2:=c2.Error(errors.New("second")); c2.SetAccepted("application/json","text/html")
 copied:=c2.Copy()
 messages:=[]string{}; for _,e:=range copied.Errors {messages=append(messages,e.Error())}
 formats:=append([]string{},copied.Accepted...)
 if len(copied.Errors)>0 {copied.Errors[0]=&Error{Err:errors.New("changed"),Type:ErrorTypePrivate}}
 if len(copied.Accepted)>0 {copied.Accepted[0]="text/plain"}
 c3,_:=CreateTestContext(httptest.NewRecorder()); nilcopy:=c3.Copy()
 empty,_:=CreateTestContext(httptest.NewRecorder()); empty.Errors=make(errorMsgs,0); empty.Accepted=make([]string,0); emptycopy:=empty.Copy()
 _=e1; _=e2
 isolation:=map[string]any{"errors":messages,"accepted":formats,"original_error":c2.Errors[0].Error(),"original_accepted":c2.Accepted[0],"nil_errors":nilcopy.Errors==nil,"nil_accepted":nilcopy.Accepted==nil,"empty_errors_len":len(emptycopy.Errors),"empty_accepted_len":len(emptycopy.Accepted)}
 data,_:=json.Marshal(map[string]any{"existing":existing,"isolation":isolation}); fmt.Printf("FROZEN_OBSERVATION:%s\n",data)
}
'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='codex-ab-gin-observer-') as directory:
    private = pathlib.Path(directory)
    while True:
        identity = uuid.uuid4().hex
        virtual = pathlib.Path.cwd() / ('zz_codex_ab_observer_' + identity + '_test.go')
        if not os.path.lexists(virtual): break
    test_name = 'TestCodexABContextObservation' + identity
    backing = private / 'observer_test.go'
    backing.write_text(source.replace('TestFrozenContextObservation', test_name))
    overlay = private / 'overlay.json'
    overlay.write_text(json.dumps({'Replace': {str(virtual): str(backing)}}))
    result = subprocess.run(['go','test','-overlay',str(overlay),'.', '-run', '^' + test_name + '$', '-count=1', '-v'], text=True, capture_output=True)
if result.returncode:
    sys.stderr.write(result.stdout + result.stderr)
    sys.exit(result.returncode)
rows = [line.removeprefix('FROZEN_OBSERVATION:') for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('FROZEN_OBSERVATION:')]
if len(rows) != 1: raise RuntimeError('missing or repeated observation')
print(json.dumps(json.loads(rows[0])[json.load(sys.stdin)['scope']]))
